==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I battled a Were-Hunter in the forest. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees. ) (The Were-Hunter resembles an elven man with long silver hair, a red ascot worn over his mouth, a long black duster, black cowboy boots, and a black fedora. He wields a ranged weapon that resembles a bear trap on a chain.) The hunter was unaware that the Alligator Men were no longer barbarians. (He also seemed to be unaware that most of the Alligator Men weren't even in this world anymore, since I sent most of them to a golden paradise world not too long ago.) (The Alligator Men resemble humanoid alligators dressed like barbarians.) I spawned a robot behind the hunter and transferred my mind into it, in order to knock him out with a sucker punch. (I spawned the robot using the Fingo spell and transferred my mind into it using the Ligo spell. I had to use this trick to outsmart him, because he was seemingly too fast to hit otherwise. He damaged my normal body, but I was able to recover and transfer my mind back into it using Ligo.)
